source: SVO Koester koester2 DA LTE, 4 pi H_lambda, air wavelengths
cooling: Bedard et al. 2020 C/O core; default q_H=1e-4, optional thin q_H=1e-10; q_He=1e-2
units: 10-pc F_lambda for R=1 Rsun, 1e-18 W m^-2 nm^-1

uv_calibration: 71 low-proper-motion local DA anchors, 6812--41430 K; constant FUV/NUV passband correction
